CARE COORDINATION NOTE - Maumee Bend Health Partners Author: Pauline Achterberg, care coordinator Date: 05/28/2081 Patient: SANTANGELO, WILHELMINA MRN 02-558314 DOB 06/21/2038 42 y/o F PCP: Dr. Corazon Bellweather Payer ID: OHM-4417-209-8
[Dictated but not read -- dictated by Ms. Achterberg into the phone system after the visit, transcribed]
This is a long note because the patient was seen in the emergency department at Toledo Riverside Emergency Department yesterday, 05/27/2081, by Dr. Hiroshi Albrecht-Tan, for a sprain of the left ankle, the second sprain in about a year, the earlier one being the right wrist on 04/15/2080. Ibuprofen 200 mg was started. She presented limping and with no way home, as the neighbour, Mr. Obadiah Fenwick, who normally drives her, was at work. The ED called me. I arranged a ride using the county transport program, voucher TV-2080-004471 still showing as active, although it was issued last year and I have asked billing to confirm it can still be used. If not, a new one is needed.
I then spoke with the patient on the phone at (419) 555-0177. She asks that we only speak with her and her daughter, Marisela Santangelo, who is now an adult. She does not want her mother Rosalind called, and she does not want her ex-partner Terrence Goode to have any information. She is unemployed since 03/01/2078 and I am working on benefits. Her sister -- strike that, her mother's sister, Aunt Carmelina -- may be able to help with rides on weekends. Actually, scratch that, her real sister's name is Dorothea and she lives in Dayton. Please correct the dictation if I have this wrong.
The son, Ezekiel, is seven years old and attends the school on Marlowe Avenue. The neighbour's dog is also named Ezekiel, and the patient says the school once called the wrong house. Please do not combine these.
Housing: the landlord, Mr. Anselmo Duarte-Whitfeld, has been sending text messages about the rent and the broken steps. Patient forwarded them to me and I paste them here with her permission:
----- pasted ----- Sun, May 25, 8:41 AM From: Anselmo D-W (419) 555-0194 Wilhemina rent was due on the 1st. I told you the step is not my problem, you fell last yr. Pay by friday or I start the paperwork. Mon, May 26, 6:03 PM From: Anselmo D-W Ive cleaned out the porch. your stuff is by the dumpster at 1409 Marlowe Ave. Call me. -- Sent from my iPhone (419) 555-0194 Anselmo Duarte-Whitfield, Property Mgr, Duarte-Whitfield Rentals LLC IP: 192.168.1.44 ----- end paste -----
Plan: 1. Legal aid referral. 2. Transport voucher renewal. 3. Dental follow up with Dr. Mbali Dlamini at Glass City Dental Collective in July. 4. Check in by phone in 2 weeks. 5. Ibuprofen with food.
Page 2 of 2 -- SANTAGELO, WILHELMINA -- MRN 02-558314 Routed to: Dr. Bellweather; Rafael Quist MA. Signed P Achterberg 05/28/2081 15:40.
